  "key_numbers": [
    "14 patients with thalamic pain and 15 age-matched healthy controls.",
    "FC between amygdala (nonaffected side) and brainstem significantly higher in patients (t[26] = 5.30, p-FDR = .019).",
    "FC between BLA (nonaffected side) and VTA significantly higher in patients (t[26] = 2.07, uncorrected P = .048).",
